• **Santosh Trophy:**

 
 
• The Santosh Trophy is an annual Indian football tournament contested by states and government institutions.
 
• It was founded in 1941 and is named after the late Maharaja Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhary of Santosh.
 
• The tournament is managed by the All India Football Federation (AIFF).
 
• It serves as a platform for players to showcase their talent at a national level.
 
 
 
• **Services Football Team:**
 
 
• The Services team is composed of players from various Indian military and paramilitary organizations.
 
• They have a strong presence in Indian football and have won the Santosh Trophy multiple times.
 
• The team is known for its disciplined and tactical style of play.
 
• Services teams often dominate in physical and endurance aspects of the game.
 
 
 
• **Goa Football Team:**
 
 
• Goa is one of the prominent football-playing states in India with a rich football history.
 
• The Goa football team has won the Santosh Trophy several times and is known for its attacking football style.
 
• Football is a popular sport in Goa, with a strong local fan base and numerous football clubs.
 
 
 
• **Golden Jubilee Stadium:**
 
 
• The Golden Jubilee Stadium is a significant sports venue in India.
 
• It hosts various national and regional sports events, including football matches.
 
• The stadium offers modern facilities and has a seating capacity for a large number of spectators.
